title: कुसि निबन्धय् प्रगतिवाद
nepali: साहित्यया प्यंगू विधा कविता, आख्यान, नाटक व निबन्ध मध्ये छगू न्हूगु उत्कृष्ट गद्य साहित्य विधा निबन्ध खः । १६औं शताब्दी फ्रान्सं शुरु जूगु निबन्ध विधा नेपालभाषा साहित्य खेलय्‌ झण्डै सोसःत्या दँ लिपातिनि खनेदत । थोहे झ्वलय्‌ आधुनिक निबन्धकारया रूपय्‌ खनेदुम्ह छम्ह निबन्धकार पद्मरत्न तुलाधर खः । पद्मरत्न तुलाधरया निबन्ध नेपालभाषा साहित्य खेलय्‌ सफल निबन्ध कथं दुथ्यागु दु । पद्मरत्नया बुलुमि निबन्ध पुचः(नेसं १०८३), बाथरुम मेमेगु निबन्ध (नेसं ११३२) व लुमं लुमं न्ह्याइपुसे च्वं ! (नेसं ११३५) यानाः सोंगू निबन्ध संग्रह पिदंगु दु । थुगु चोसुइ बुलुमि निबन्ध संग्रहय्‌ दुथ्याःगु झिपु निबन्धमध्ये कुसि निबन्धयात जक दुवालाः कुसि निबन्धयात प्रगतिवादी सिद्घान्तया आधारय्‌ विश्लेषण जूगु दु । अथे हे प्रगतिवाद सिद्धान्तयात छेलाः निबन्धय्‌ दुथ्याःगु मूल्य मान्यता, बिचा:, चिन्तनया विश्लेषण जूगू दु । चोसुया लागि प्राथमिक जोलंकथं बुलुमि निबन्ध संग्रहयात नालातःगु दुसा द्वितीयक स्रोतकथं पद्मरत्न तुलाधर व वय्‌कःया विषयवस्तुलिसे स्वापू दुगु प्रकाशित थीथी सफू व लेख रचनात संकलन यानाः अध्ययन जूगु दु ।
american_english: Among the four genres of literature—poetry, fiction, drama, and essay—one modern and distinguished prose literature genre is the essay. The essay genre, which originated in France in the 16th century, emerged in the arena of Nepal Bhasa literature only nearly three hundred and fifty years later. In this very progression, one essayist who emerges in the form of a modern essayist is Padma Ratna Tuladhar. Padma Ratna Tuladhar's essays are recognized as successful essays in the arena of Nepal Bhasa literature. Three essay collections by Padma Ratna have been published, namely Bulumi Nibandha Pucha (NS 1083), Bathroom Memegu Nibandha (NS 1132), and Luman Luman Nhyayipuse Chwan! (NS 1135). In this article, selecting only the essay 'Kusi' out of the ten essays included in the Bulumi essay collection, the essay 'Kusi' has been analyzed on the basis of progressive theory. Likewise, applying progressive theory, an analysis of the values, thoughts, and reflections contained in the essay has been conducted. For the article, the Bulumi essay collection has been adopted as the primary source, while various published books and articles related to Padma Ratna Tuladhar and his subject matter have been collected and studied as secondary sources.

Along that very path, one chap who emerges as a proper modern essayist is Padma Ratna Tuladhar. Padma Ratna Tuladhar's essays are widely recognized as successful essays in the arena of Nepal Bhasa literature. Three essay collections by Padma Ratna have been published over time, namely Bulumi Nibandha Pucha (NS 1083), Bathroom Memegu Nibandha (NS 1132), and Luman Luman Nhyayipuse Chwan! (NS 1135). In this article, selecting only the essay 'Kusi' out of the ten essays included in the Bulumi essay collection, the essay 'Kusi' has been analysed on the basis of progressive theory. Likewise, applying progressive theory, an analysis of the values, thoughts, and reflections contained in the essay has been carried out. For the article, the Bulumi essay collection has been used as the primary material, while various published books and articles related to Padma Ratna Tuladhar and his subject matter have been gathered and studied as secondary sources.
